events.line: Faton, you absolute coward—Bo Nix just dropped 24 points on your bench while you started whatever geriatric QB you were too scared to bench, and now you're gonna spend all week wondering what could've been.

Rilind benched Stafford and watched him put up 20.9 points on the fucking bench—that's what happens when you panic-swap your QB like a goddamn coward instead of letting him cook against a shit defense.
Rilind benched a tight end who just dropped 20.6 points on his ass—congrats on leaving 13 points on the bench like a fucking idiot, maybe next time trust your lineup instead of overthinking it.
Rob really said "nah, I don't need 20 fucking points" and left Wilson on the bench—absolute masterclass in fantasy incompetence, my guy.

Rob really said "nah, I don't trust this guy" and benched a TE who just put up 20 fucking points—that's what happens when you panic-check the waiver wire at 11:55 PM and second-guess yourself like a coward.
Ilir benched Juwan Johnson and watched him put up 19.3 points from the couch—that's what happens when you panic and don't trust your guys, you absolute donkey.

Nori really said "nah, I don't trust the guy putting up 18 points" and benched Jordan Love like he was some waiver-wire lottery ticket—congrats on leaving nearly 20 points on your bench while your starter probably shit the bed.
Nori, you absolute coward—benched Addison when he was gonna drop 17.5 on your ass, and now you're gonna spend all week wondering what the fuck you were thinking.

Ilir actually benched his brain this week and started Bijan Robinson anyway—somehow his autopilot is smarter than his conscious decision-making, and Robinson just dropped a fat 34.3 to make him look like an accidental genius.

Arben really said "nah, I don't need 15 points on my bench" and left that shit there to rot while his starter probably pulled a hamstring in the third quarter—absolute masterclass in fucking up a sure thing.
